comment: Example workspaces, one folder each under examples/. `tools/differential/jaic_sweep.py examples` runs every case natively with its `args` (`mode: check` only compiles it; `exit_code` is the status a program is expected to return), and tools/browser/check_scripting_wasm.mjs and tools/browser/check_browser_release.mjs run the bundled ones in the wasm engine under `budget` basic blocks, the hosted playground's limit. Each line of stdout_contains must appear in stdout; stdout_excludes must not. A case with `bundle: true` is listed in the browser bundle's examples.json, in this order, with its `title` and one-sentence `summary`: tools/browser/build_scripting_wasm.py copies its directory to <id>/ together with examples/jacket.toml (docs/browser/playground.md). Every folder of examples/ needs a case.
